run_cmd_with_env: run a shell command with custom environment variables and capture stdout or write to an output file
read_sys_configs: read system configuration including CPU cores, sockets, threads per core, and total memory in GB
find_java_home: find the JAVA_HOME path by checking common JDK install locations or resolving via the java command
read_environ: read and validate environment variables PROJ_ROOT, JAVA_HOME, and SPARK_HOME with fallback defaults
is_distro_like: check if the current OS distribution matches a given distro ID by parsing /etc/os-release
